_source: Generated by backend/scripts/calibrate_committee_routing.py from app/data/committee_routing_examples.json and app/data/committee_jurisdictions.json (all-MiniLM-L6-v2): k, alpha, temperature and threshold for committee routing, chosen by F0.5 on the issues dated before 2026-08-17 (each scored against the other training issues more than 3 days away). held_out scores the issues dated 2026-08-24 or later against all training issues; precision and recall are [value, 2.5%, 97.5%] bootstrap intervals over issues. prototypes_only is the best setting with alpha = 1 (no labelled votes), for comparison.
